_note: Bundled reference advisories for OFFLINE demo only. Live mode discovers advisories at runtime with Tavily. Always confirm details on the vendor page before acting.

advisories.title: Cisco IOS XE Software Web UI Privilege Escalation
advisories.affected_versions: Cisco IOS XE Software with the Web UI feature enabled (16.x and 17.x trains before fixed releases)
advisories.fixed_versions: See vendor advisory for per-train fixed releases (e.g. 17.9.4a, 17.6.6a, 17.3.8a, 16.12.10a)
advisories.vulnerable_feature: HTTP Server / Web UI (ip http server or ip http secure-server)
advisories.exploitation_conditions: Web UI reachable by the attacker, i.e. 'ip http server' or 'ip http secure-server' configured
advisories.workaround: no ip http server and no ip http secure-server on internet-facing systems, or restrict access with an ACL

advisories.title: PAN-OS: OS Command Injection Vulnerability in GlobalProtect
advisories.exploitation_conditions: Firewall configured with a GlobalProtect gateway or portal
advisories.workaround: Upgrade to a fixed hotfix; Threat Prevention signatures as interim mitigation per advisory

advisories.title: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA and FTD Software VPN Web Server Remote Code Execution
advisories.fixed_versions: 7.0.8.1, 7.2.10.2, 7.4.2.4, 7.6.2.1, 7.7.10.1 (7.1 and 7.3: migrate to a fixed release; confirm with the Cisco Software Checker)
advisories.vulnerable_feature: VPN web server: AnyConnect SSL VPN, or AnyConnect IKEv2 remote access with client services
advisories.exploitation_conditions: Remote access VPN web server enabled on a reachable interface (webvpn enabled with AnyConnect); attacker needs valid VPN credentials, and chaining CVE-2025-20362 removes that requirement. Exploited in the wild (CISA ED 25-03)
advisories.workaround: No workaround; upgrade to a fixed release

advisories.title: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA and FTD Software VPN Web Server Unauthorized Access
advisories.vulnerable_feature: VPN web server: AnyConnect SSL VPN, or AnyConnect IKEv2 remote access with client services
advisories.exploitation_conditions: Remote access VPN web server enabled on a reachable interface; unauthenticated attacker reaches restricted URL endpoints. Chained with CVE-2025-20333 in the wild
advisories.workaround: No workaround; upgrade to a fixed release

advisories.title: Cisco ISE and ISE-PIC Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution
advisories.affected_versions: Cisco ISE and ISE-PIC 3.3 (before 3.3 Patch 7) and 3.4 (before 3.4 Patch 2); 3.2 and earlier are not affected
advisories.fixed_versions: 3.3 Patch 7, 3.4 Patch 2 (earlier hot patches do not fix CVE-2025-20337)
advisories.vulnerable_feature: A specific ISE API present on every node; affected regardless of device configuration
advisories.exploitation_conditions: Network reachability to the ISE node; no configuration prerequisite. Unauthenticated attacker can run commands as root
advisories.workaround: No workaround; upgrade to 3.3 Patch 7 or 3.4 Patch 2

advisories.title: Cisco ISE on Cloud Platforms Static Credential Vulnerability
advisories.affected_versions: Cisco ISE cloud deployments: AWS 3.1-3.4, Azure 3.2-3.4, OCI 3.2-3.4
advisories.fixed_versions: See vendor advisory (hot fix and fixed releases)
advisories.vulnerable_feature: ISE deployed on AWS, Azure or OCI with the Primary Administration node running in the cloud
advisories.exploitation_conditions: Primary Administration node in a public cloud; on-premises Primary Administration nodes are not affected
advisories.workaround: No workaround; restrict access to cloud ISE with allow-lists and apply the fix
